exam_scheme.note: MAH-LL.B. Common Entrance Test is conducted annually by the State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra for admission into Government, Government-Aided, University Departments, and Unaided Law Colleges across Maharashtra (including Government Law College Mumbai and ILS Law College Pune). The examination is conducted separately for the 3-Year LL.B. course (post-graduation) and the 5-Year Integrated LL.B. course (B.A. LL.B., B.B.A. LL.B., B.L.S. LL.B. post-higher secondary). Effective Academic Year 2025-26 and confirmed for 2026-27 vide Public Notice No. HED-1124/C.R.32/Public Notice/141/2025 dated 28 Jan 2025, the total marks for both examinations were amended to 120 marks (120 objective MCQs) over 120 minutes instead of the earlier 150 marks. There is no negative marking, and the question paper is administered in English and Marathi.
